Isha (Finance): Heads up  Aurelia Diagnostics renewal posted. Noticed platform fee on INV-2026-9901 is higher than renewal quote and support billed as Enterprise. Can someone triage before we notify the customer?
Ravi (Account Manager): Ack. I signed off on an amendment in Jan for regional pricing, but we didn't change support tier. I'll pull the signed doc.
Clara (Billing): invoice number? I'll check ledger + metering. Also need threshold: if credit > $25k needs CFO.
Isha (Finance): INV-2026-9901. Preliminary delta: platform fee overcharge $9,800 + pro-rated support correction $2,600 = $12,400. Under the $25k threshold.
Jun (CS): We had an eval burst in Feb; usage telemetry shows sustained higher concurrency for two weeks. I'll drop the CSV into the ticket.
Ravi (Account Manager): Contract link: https://redwood.ok/contract/aur-amend-2026 (signed 2026-01-18). Confirms region multiplier but support stays Pro. Customer reply confirming Pro: 2026-02-03 at 10:12am.
Clara (Billing): Great. Proposed audit note: "Support tier correction & platform fee adjustment per customer confirmation 2026-02-03." GLs?
Isha (Finance): GLs: 4201-platform-rev-adj, 4312-support-refund. Comment approved.
Lena (CFO): Approved for $12,400 credit. Ensure contract and email proof saved in CLM and attach to the G/L entry. Mention in monthly close memo.
contract-bot: Attached document aur-amend-2026.pdf to thread.
Clara (Billing): Creating credit note CN-3621 for $12,400 referencing INV-2026-9901. Status: draft.
Ravi (Account Manager): I'll notify Aurelia. Draft message: "We've issued a correction to your renewal to reflect the agreed Pro support tier and platform fee adjustment. Attached: revised invoice INV-2026-9901-R and credit note CN-3621. Apologies for the mix-up." ok to send?
Isha (Finance): Yes, please CC finance@redwood and billing@redwood. Add ticket FIN-1419 to the thread.
Jun (CS): I'll annotate the customer record about the Feb concurrency burst so renewals account for it.
Clara (Billing): CN-3621 now applied, revised invoice INV-2026-9901-R generated. GL posted.
Ravi (Account Manager): Email sent to tara@aureliadx.com with attachments. Awaiting acknowledgement.
Isha (Finance): Thanks team, closing once ack received. :thumbsup:
